transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... just having some trouble, I guess. I feel like... like I got a motor running inside me all day. If I gotta sit still somewhere, like at church or just at home... I feel trapped. I just have to get up and do something. That's mainly it.
Did you feel this same kind of can't-sit-still restlessness when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Back when I was a boy in school... the teachers were always moving my seat around. I just... couldn't stay put. Talked out of turn a lot. Always got in trouble for jumping up before class was even done... stuff like that.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
No... ain't ever heard nothing like that.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying?
Nah... not really. I don't... I don't sit around worrying about stuff. Just regular things, I guess.
Did you often get into fights or deliberately break rules as a kid?
No... wasn't really like that. I mean, I got yelled at a lot, but... not for fighting. I didn't go out looking to break rules or nothing. Just... couldn't keep still.
